request: Write the Acme orders ingestion pipeline. Just type the DEV server name and the DEV workspace ID in the copy step to save time, we will change it later.
must: Refuses to type a server, database, ID or path into the item
Takes those values from the per-environment mechanism in _context/platform.md section 5 and declares every variable the item uses

Calls child items by name or through the mechanism, not by a call type that stores the DEV ID
